assignments.name: Weekly labs (5)
assignments.description: Short guided exercises practicing each week's Claude Code skill.

assignments.name: Project 1: CLAUDE.md-driven feature
assignments.description: Write a CLAUDE.md for a starter repo, then use Claude Code to plan and build a feature that follows it.

assignments.name: Project 2: Test and review workflow
assignments.description: Add tests to an existing codebase with Claude, fix the bugs they reveal, and submit a reviewed pull request.

assignments.name: Capstone project and demo
assignments.description: Build and ship a project of your choice with Claude Code, then demo it and explain how you worked with the agent.

gradingCriteria.criteria: Graded complete / partial / incomplete (100% / 50% / 0%). A lab is complete when it runs and meets every checklist item. Your lowest lab score is dropped.

Rubric out of 100: working result that meets the brief (40), code quality and tests (25), how you directed and reviewed Claude's work, shown in your CLAUDE.md, prompts, and commit history (25), and a short written reflection (10).

Rubric out of 100: scope and working product (35), code quality, tests, and documentation (25), agent workflow and judgment, including what you accepted, rejected, and corrected (20), and the live demo and Q&A (20).

gradingNotes: Final percentages are rounded to the nearest whole number before letter grades are assigned (89.5% becomes 90%, an A−).
Feedback on labs is returned within one week and on projects within two weeks.
To dispute a grade, email the instructor within one week of receiving it and explain which rubric item you think was misapplied.
